# Review of SEEN-108, attempt 2, from the seen-reviewer subagent

Spawned on opus with the task text of triage record 31 and nothing else. It read
the ticket, all 31 records and the whole 28-file focus set, and returned a
verdict of `return` with nine findings. Recorded here in full because a note is
not capped; the review record's own shape, with `independence: subagent`, is
written when this ticket next reaches the review gate.

The reviewer judged `slice_files` (the triage's one failed check) to be a defect
in the plan rather than in the diff: harness/delivery.py and
harness/tests/test_skill.py are real slice 4 work, the first because it is the
only other caller of kpi.measure and the delivered kpi.json must carry the same
execution figures the report does, the second because it holds criterion 5's
only test. No finding, because there is no failure scenario.

## Findings

- **F1, high, harness/agents.py:130.** `routed()` falls back to the strongest
  tier whenever the branch cannot be read, so `doctor` reports drift on the
  committed implementer copies of any commit routed below opus, and CI's harness
  self-check fails on every `pull_request` event. `actions/checkout` leaves HEAD
  detached on that event, so `branch_or_none()` is None. Reproduced against this
  branch's own commit adbdb4c, whose committed copy reads haiku at medium
  effort: `routed()` returns ('opus', 'high') and `drift()` reports both copies,
  so the same commit is green on push and red on its pull request. It ships
  silently and breaks the next ticket's pull request instead.
- **F2, medium, harness/kpi.py:158.** `ran_on` reads `model` off the record
  envelope rather than `record['data']`, and indexes the latest tdd advance's
  slice list by route position, so it is null for every slice. Confirmed on this
  ticket's own journal: all four entries read null. SEEN-109's whole window is
  the difference between the routed model and the model the work ran on in
  shadow, so it reads an empty column. The test asserts only
  `assertIn('ran_on', entry)` and passes with the behaviour removed.
- **F3, medium, the ticket file.** The amendment redefining criterion 1 is
  attributed to Ruud and dated, but no record in the journal carries a human
  decision; SEEN-105's comparable amendment points at the note holding the
  options offered and the one chosen.
- **F4, medium, harness/cli.py:903.** Criterion 4's report half is proven only at
  helper level. Deleting the two lines that populate `cost_by_model` and `prices`
  leaves all 751 tests green and the sprint report printing no cost row at all.
- **F5, medium, harness/kpi.py:174.** In shadow every slice runs on the session's
  model, but `cost_cents` prices it at the routed model's price, so the figure is
  a counterfactual presented as a cost. Slice 3 is routed haiku and priced at
  9.46 cents on 23,659 output tokens; every check of that slice was recorded
  under claude-opus-5, where the same tokens cost about 177 cents at this table's
  own price. SEEN-109 decides whether to take the routes off shadow from exactly
  that table, so the measurement is guaranteed to show a saving that has not
  happened, and with `ran_on` null nothing in the record contradicts it.
- **F6, low, record 23.** Slice 4's recorded `failure_reason` names a KeyError on
  `execution` that does not appear in check 19's captured output; the dominant
  failure there is `TypeError: measure() got an unexpected keyword argument
  'rules'`, seven times.
- **F7, low, harness/kpi.py:174.** `cost_cents` returns fractional cents as a
  float, against the ground rule that amounts are cents as integers with a
  currency code.
- **F8, low, docs/harness/skill.md.** The heading still reads "The two agents"
  above a paragraph and a table describing three.
- **F9, low, harness/routing.py.** The route record carries no spawn instruction,
  which the clarify record's own restatement of criterion 3 promised it would.

## What this session verified before acting

F1 reproduced by exporting commit adbdb4c into a scratch tree, detaching HEAD and
calling `agents.routed` and `agents.drift`: None, ('opus', 'high'), both copies
reported. F2 reproduced by calling `kpi.execution` on this ticket's own journal:
`ran_on` null for positions 1 to 4. F5 read off the same call: slice 3 routed
haiku, cost 9.46, against checks 14 to 18 all recorded under claude-opus-5.
